integrity: The exact Fourier proof is included. The standalone integer tests cover only finite domains; they are not used as universal proof. Literature comparison and self-review do not constitute independent mathematical validation or exhaustive novelty certification.
limitations: Applies to odd moduli n>=3 in base n-1 with signed digit parity and integer cutoffs. Does not establish signs or asymptotics of individual residue sums, nor an analogous statement for even n or other bases.
title: All odd-modulus Newman digit sums satisfy the Shevelev–Moses identity
